ApplicationIdentifier.label: Application Identifier
ApplicationIdentifier.description: Two digits saying what kind of number follows, carried over from the GS1-128 barcode the number was printed as.

CheckDigit.label: Check Digit
CheckDigit.description: A digit derived from the serial number, used to catch a misread number.

CountryCode.label: Country Code
CountryCode.description: A code for the country whose postal service issued the number.

DestinationZip.label: Destination ZIP
DestinationZip.description: The postal code the package is addressed to.

PackageId.label: Package ID
PackageId.description: Identifies the package within the shipper's own numbering.

RoutingApplicationId.label: Routing Application ID
RoutingApplicationId.description: The fixed prefix, which marks the destination postal code that follows it.

SCNC.label: SCNC
SCNC.description: The Serial Container Numeric Code, two digits identifying the carrier.

SerialNumber.label: Serial Number
SerialNumber.description: The part of the number the check digit is calculated from.

ServiceType.label: Service Type
ServiceType.description: A code for the delivery service used.

ShipperId.label: Shipper ID
ShipperId.description: Identifies the account that shipped the package.

ShippingContainerType.label: Container Type
ShippingContainerType.description: A code for the kind of container the number was printed on.
